## 13. Performance profile: wall time per stage (full system, held-out v2 traces)

| stage | n | p50 ms | p90 ms | p95 ms |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| controller: chunk received -> retrieve / wait / skip decision | 241 | 0.910 | 1.280 | 1.420 |
| task execution: draft | 95 | 3.680 | 12.480 | 21.370 |
| task execution: generation | 81 | 1636.980 | 2970.400 | 3964.720 |
| task execution: retrieval | 143 | 9.470 | 17.020 | 20.250 |
| queue wait: draft | 95 | 0.030 | 0.040 | 0.050 |
| queue wait: generation | 81 | 0.040 | 0.060 | 0.070 |
| queue wait: retrieval | 143 | 0.050 | 0.070 | 0.120 |
| generation (extractive) | 90 | 0.030 | 0.040 | 0.040 |
| generation (ollama) | 78 | 1491.400 | 2276.750 | 2974.380 |

> 'task execution: generation' = LLM call + claim verification + citation validation + repair for a final answer; 'draft' = extractive draft + verification. Verification alone is measured in the batch pipeline (§1 latency table, verification_ms).
